summary.zh: 从贴纸页上把贴纸一角掀起来（能看到白色背面），整张揭下，甩到笔记本盖子上“啪”地贴住。可以自己拖，没人碰时有根手指在演示。
summary.en: Lift a sticker’s corner off the sheet (you can see its white back), peel it off and slap it onto a laptop lid. Drag them yourself; a ghost finger demos it when idle.

technique.zh: 揭角 = 沿折线把贴纸切成两半：正面用 clip-path 去掉折起的那块，背面是同一张图关于折线的镜像，再裁成同一块。折线跟着手指走，拿起时放大一点（离镜头更近），贴上时压扁回弹。
technique.en: Peeling = cutting the sticker along a fold line: the front is clipped to remove the folded part; the back is the same art mirrored across the fold line and clipped to that piece. The fold follows the finger; lifting scales up a touch, slapping squashes and rebounds.

desc.zh: 掀起多少（相对贴纸尺寸）
贴上那一下压扁到多少

adapt.zh: 适合成就、徽章、个性化页面。折线算法是通用的，换成任何 SVG 都能揭。
adapt.en: Great for achievements, badges or profile pages. The fold maths works with any SVG.
